observations: Photo 0 shows multiple boxes of Hikvision ColorVu cameras, stacked in a cardboard box. The boxes are colorful with rainbow patterns and feature images of bullet and dome cameras.
Photo 1 shows a close-up of a Hikvision Color Camera label on a white camera body, still in plastic wrap. The label includes model number DS-2CD2347G0-IU, 5mm lens, and serial number.
Photo 2 shows an open box with a camera inside, wrapped in plastic, and a bundle of cables (likely BNC or power) also wrapped in plastic, resting on foam padding.
All cameras appear to be new and unopened, with no visible signs of use or damage.
No DVR is visible in any photo.
